card.name: Summing-up phrases like "all in all"
card.fires_on: The last word of a sentence-opening summary or concluding phrase, such as "all in all", "in short", "in any case" and "overall,". It fires right before the main clause of the conclusion begins.

modes.label: In all / in short
modes.description: The closing word of a fixed summing-up phrase that opens a sentence.
modes.example: In<< short>>, the New Culture Movement advocated and debated

modes.label: In any/either case or event
modes.description: The last word of a phrase meaning "regardless", opening a sentence.

modes.label: Overall comma
modes.description: The comma after a sentence-initial "Overall" that introduces a conclusion.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward starting a new concluding clause after the phrase, but the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the end of a "to sum up" or "in any case" opener, just before the main point of the sentence.
